mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish: expect 70 degrees with partly cloudy skies near the Military Ridge State Trail. If you are looking up tonight, the International Space Station will be visible starting at 8:25 PM, passing from the northwest near Verona High School toward the northeast near Home Depot.
We have no new important emails to report, and city records remain quiet as we head into the afternoon.

There is plenty to do in town, starting with the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market happening today. You can also catch live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, or grab pizza and a pitcher at Lake Lou-ee, all happening today.

In our weekly police update, on September 5, officers responded to reports of multiple vehicles having cheese slices left on their windshields throughout the city, which was identified as a social media prank.
Culver's remains open until 10 PM today, though please note that the store is currently closed for a remodel.
